story.text: 빨갛고 하얀 목마 등대 두 개가 마주 선 이호테우 해변, 노을이 수평선 너머로 저물고 있었다.
story.reading: ppal-gat-go ha-yan mong-ma deung-dae du gae-ga ma-ju seon i-ho-te-u hae-byeon, no-eul-i su-pyeong-seon neo-meo-ro jeo-mul-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: At Iho Tewoo Beach, where the red and white horse-shaped lighthouses stand facing each other, the sunset was sinking beyond the horizon.

story.text: 등대에 불이 하나둘 켜지자, 용우가 걸음을 멈추고 나를 바라본다. 평소보다 표정이 굳어 있었다.
story.reading: deung-dae-e bul-i ha-na-dul kyeo-ji-ja, yong-u-ga geol-eum-eul meom-chu-go na-reul ba-ra-bon-da. pyeong-so-bo-da pyo-jeong-i gud-eo iss-eot-da.
story.en: As the lighthouse lights came on one by one, Yongwoo stopped walking and looked at me. His expression was more tense than usual.

story.text: '저 수평선 볼 때마다 너 생각했다. 옆에 있어도 자꾸 보고 싶고, 그게 이상하다고 생각했는데.'
story.reading: jeo su-pyeong-seon bol ttae-ma-da neo saeng-gak-aet-da. yeop-e iss-eo-do ja-kku bo-go sip-go, geu-ge i-sang-ha-da-go saeng-gak-aet-neun-de.
story.en: 'Every time I looked at that horizon, I thought of you. Even with you right beside me, I kept wanting to see you more — I thought that was strange.'

story.text: 목소리가 미세하게 떨리는 게 느껴졌다. 용우가 이렇게 긴장한 모습은 처음이었다.
story.reading: mok-so-ri-ga mi-se-ha-ge tteol-li-neun ge neu-kkyeo-jyeot-da. yong-u-ga i-reo-ke gin-jang-han mo-seub-eun cheo-eum-i-eot-da.
story.en: I could tell his voice was trembling slightly. It was the first time I'd ever seen Yongwoo this nervous.

story.text: '이상한 게 아니더라. 그게 그냥… 내 진심이었다. 동생이 아니라, 좋아하는 사람으로.'
story.reading: i-sang-han ge a-ni-deo-ra. geu-ge geu-nyang, nae jin-sim-i-eot-da. dong-saeng-i a-ni-ra, jo-a-ha-neun sa-ram-eu-ro.
story.en: 'It wasn't strange at all. It was just... my true heart. Not as a sibling, but as someone I like.'

story.text: 파도 소리를 배경 삼아, 용우가 마침내 고백한다. '형이니 동생이니, 그런 말로는 이제 안 되겠다. 나 너 좋아한다. …좋아한다고, 마. 와 이제 와서 딴소리하겠노.' 늘 방송처럼 또렷하던 발음이 무너지고, 숨겨왔던 부산 사투리가 고스란히 드러났다. 그게 오히려 어떤 말보다 진짜 같았다.
story.reading: pa-do so-ri-reul bae-gyeong sam-a, yong-u-ga ma-chim-nae go-baek-an-da. hyeong-i-ni dong-saeng-i-ni, geu-reon mal-lo-neun i-je an doe-get-da. na neo jo-a-han-da. jo-a-han-da-go, ma. wa i-je wa-seo ttan-so-ri-ha-get-no. neul bang-song-cheo-reom tto-ryeot-ha-deon bal-eum-i mu-neo-ji-go, sum-gyeo-wat-deon bu-san sa-tu-ri-ga go-seu-ran-hi deu-reo-nat-da. geu-ge o-hi-ryeo eo-tteon mal-bo-da jin-jja gat-at-da.
story.en: With the sound of the waves as a backdrop, Yongwoo finally confesses. ''Older brother,' 'younger sibling' — those words don't work anymore. I like you. ...I said I like you, seriously. Why would I go back on it now.' The radio-clear diction he'd always kept, even mid-flight, gave way completely, and the Busan dialect he'd hidden for so long came spilling out plain and unguarded. Somehow it felt more real than any polished sentence could have.

story.text: 심장이 터질 것 같아 아무 말도 못 하는 나를 보며 용우가 슬쩍 웃는다. '대답은 천천히 해도 된다. 대신 오늘 대화 몇 개는 잘 들어봐라, 나만큼 떨렸을 사람들 얘기니까.'
story.reading: sim-jang-i teo-jil geot gat-a a-mu mal-do mot ha-neun na-reul bo-myeo yong-u-ga seul-jjak us-neun-da. dae-dab-eun cheon-cheon-hi hae-do doen-da. dae-sin o-neul dae-hwa myeot gae-neun jal deul-eo-bwa-ra, na-man-keum tteol-lyeoss-eul sa-ram-deul yae-gi-ni-kka.
story.en: Seeing me speechless with my heart about to burst, Yongwoo smiles faintly. 'You can take your time answering. But listen to today's conversations carefully — they're about people who were probably just as nervous as I was.'

words.example: 이호테우 해변에는 빨갛고 하얀 목마 등대가 있다.
words.example_reading: i-ho-te-u hae-byeon-e-neun ppal-gat-go ha-yan mong-ma deung-dae-ga it-da
words.example_en: There are red and white horse-shaped lighthouses at Iho Tewoo Beach.
The sun set completely beyond the horizon.

words.meaning: Entirely, without loss, just as it is
words.example_en: The dialect he'd hidden away came out completely, unfiltered.

words.example: 그 말은 그의 진심에서 나온 것이었다.
words.example_reading: geu mal-eun geu-ui jin-sim-e-seo na-on geos-i-eot-da
words.example_en: Those words came from his true heart.
His voice trembled slightly out of nervousness.

sentences.ko: 빨갛고 하얀 등대 두 개가 마주 선 해변에 노을이 저물고 있었다.
sentences.reading: ppal-gat-go ha-yan deung-dae du gae-ga ma-ju seon hae-byeon-e no-eul-i jeo-mul-go iss-eot-da
sentences.en: The sunset was fading at the beach where two red and white lighthouses stood facing each other.

sentences.ko: 그는 수평선을 보며 자꾸 내 생각이 났다고 조용히 말했다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun su-pyeong-seon-eul bo-myeo ja-kku nae saeng-gak-i nat-da-go jo-yong-hi mal-haet-da
sentences.en: He quietly said that looking at the horizon kept making him think of me.

sentences.ko: 고백하는 순간 그가 숨겨왔던 사투리가 고스란히 드러났다.
sentences.reading: go-baek-a-neun sun-gan geu-ga sum-gyeo-wat-deon sa-tu-ri-ga go-seu-ran-hi deu-reo-nat-da
sentences.en: In the moment of his confession, the dialect he'd been hiding came out completely, unfiltered.

sentences.ko: 동생이 아니라 좋아하는 사람이라는 그의 진심이 전해졌다.
sentences.reading: dong-saeng-i a-ni-ra jo-a-ha-neun sa-ram-i-ra-neun geu-ui jin-sim-i jeon-hae-jyeot-da
sentences.en: His true feelings came through — not as a sibling, but as someone he liked.

sentences.ko: 파도 소리를 배경으로 그는 마침내 고백했다.
sentences.reading: pa-do so-ri-reul bae-gyeong-eu-ro geu-neun ma-chim-nae go-baek-aet-da
sentences.en: With the sound of the waves in the background, he finally confessed.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.en: Why have you been so quiet today?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 할 말을 정리하고 있었다. …떨려서 그런다, 지금.
turns.reading: hal mal-eul jeong-ni-ha-go iss-eot-da. tteol-lyeo-seo geu-reon-da, ji-geum.
turns.en: I was gathering my thoughts on what to say. ...I'm nervous right now, that's why.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.en: Do you get nervous too, Captain?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 너 앞에서는, 있더라. 오늘 처음 알았다.
turns.reading: neo ap-e-seo-neun, it-deo-ra. o-neul cheo-eum al-at-da.
turns.en: In front of you, apparently I do. I just found that out today.

dialogues.question: 용우가 말없이 있었던 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo was quiet?
dialogues.correct_answer: 진심을 고백하기 위해 할 말을 정리하며 긴장하고 있었다
options: 진심을 고백하기 위해 할 말을 정리하며 긴장하고 있었다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 자신의 진심을 고백하기 위해 할 말을 정리하며 긴장하고 있었습니다.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 형이니 동생이니, 그런 말로는 이제 안 되겠다. 나 너 좋아한다. 좋아한다고, 마.
turns.reading: hyeong-i-ni dong-saeng-i-ni, geu-reon mal-lo-neun i-je an doe-get-da. na neo jo-a-han-da. jo-a-han-da-go, ma.
turns.en: 'Older brother,' 'younger sibling' — those words don't work anymore. I like you. I said I like you, seriously.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.en: ...Your dialect just came out. Are you that nervous?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: …어. 이런 적 처음이다. 그냥 알아는 달라고, 내 진심이니까.
turns.reading: eo. i-reon jeok cheo-eum-i-da. geu-nyang al-a-neun dal-la-go, nae jin-sim-i-ni-kka.
turns.en: ...Yeah. This is a first for me. Just know it, that's all — it's how I really feel.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: …알겠어요. 대신 사투리 쓰는 모습, 되게 진짜 같아서 좋았어요.
turns.reading: al-gess-eo-yo. dae-sin sa-tu-ri sseu-neun mo-seub, doe-ge jin-jja gat-a-seo jo-ass-eo-yo.
turns.en: ...Okay. But hearing your dialect come out — it felt so real, and I liked it.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 용우가 사투리를 쓴 것이 손님에게 준 인상으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What impression did Yongwoo's slip into dialect leave on the passenger in this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 가식이 아니라 진심으로 느껴져서 오히려 더 신뢰가 갔다
options: 가식이 아니라 진심으로 느껴져서 오히려 더 신뢰가 갔다
dialogues.explanation: 평소 흐트러짐 없던 용우의 말투가 사투리로 무너진 순간은, 오히려 그의 고백이 진심임을 보여주는 증거로 다가왔습니다.
